description: Source code for the LimitStream class in the GuzzleHttp PSR7 package, implementing stream limiting functionality.

classes.name: LimitStream
classes.description: A decorator class that limits the number of bytes read from an underlying stream.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes LimitStream with a stream, limit, and offset.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream has reached EOF considering the limit.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the limited subset of data.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position within the limited stream.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position relative to the offset.

methods.name: setOffset
methods.description: Sets the starting offset for limiting the stream.

methods.name: setLimit
methods.description: Sets the byte limit for the stream.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream respecting the limit.
